name: RefSR-NeRF
definition: Reference-guided super-resolution neural radiation field framework combining NeRF and RefSR-CNN to achieve high-quality new perspective synthesis while balancing memory and speed.
summary: RefSR-NeRF is a framework that synthesizes high-resolution novel views from low-resolution inputs by decoupling 3D optimization from detail reconstruction via a reference-guided CNN, avoiding the memory constraints of direct high-resolution training.
